notes: Dynamax Desktop v3.1.31 includes self-service staff password recovery through the saved login-account email across all editions, with 6–128-character passwords on the updated companion. Recovery codes remain single-use and time-limited, and existing MFA and permissions are preserved. Independent CBT centres can pull the same available tests and full eligible rosters without centre assignments; signed result uploads retain per-attempt safeguards and safe concurrent retries. The student CBT page keeps the subscriber school logo. Students must complete each test at one centre; disconnected servers cannot transfer active attempts. Includes the connected HR, directory search, payment autofill, letter formatting and all previous repairs. Online features require the updated organisation backend. The 5,000-candidate software target still requires a rehearsal on the actual school server and network. Installation preserves organisation settings, payments, receipts, balances, stock and existing records.
